desc:
🔥 Every click makes you stronger! Burn giant grass fields with fire weapons, collect rare loot and hatch pets in this fire simulator.

🌾 Burn the grass and watch the whole field go up in flames
💪 Get +1 Fire Power with every click
🎁 Grab loot from the field, including Mythic and Secret items
🔥 Unlock 35+ burners, from a simple Torch to the Eternity Prism
⬆️ Upgrade your range, speed and capacity
🐾 Hatch eggs, craft pets and equip them for huge boosts
🔄 Rebirth to grow even faster
🌍 Beat World 1 and travel to World 2
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

💤 AFK friendly: stand on a training pad and keep getting stronger. Come back to offline rewards!

🆕 World 3 arrives now !

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite so you never miss a new world!
